item.title: Show HN: I built a Neovim plugin to answer questions about your config
item.summary: It might come in handy when you want to ask questions about your Neovim setup - how things work, which keymaps are available, or what a small configuration change might look like. It’s especially useful when you’re focused on your work and don’t have much time to dig through the documentation or start Googling. I know it’s not perfect, but I’d love to hear what you think. This is my first Neovim plugin. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49162216 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
